subject: Grade 8A Progress Update
message: Dear Mr. and Mrs. Banda, I wanted to update you on John's excellent progress in Mathematics this term. He has shown remarkable improvement and is now among the top performers in his class.

subject: Football Team Selection

subject: Health Check Reminder
